expectation: Membrane rings on myeloid cells (monocytes, macrophages, some DCs and MDSCs). Moderately common in a tumour: single cells or loose clusters in the stroma and around vessels, not filling tumour nests, and a distinct subset rather than every cell.
observed: A: a broad yellow haze over whole images, varying a lot from image to image and filling large tissue regions; few discrete cells. B, C: faint uniform grain with very few cell-sized dots. D: a sheet of signal between nuclei with no separate membrane rings.
why: The signal is a haze that follows tissue regions and changes by image, with no distinct ring-stained myeloid subset at any scale.
notes: CD33 shows as broad haze over whole tissue regions, at very different levels between images. The fields show grain and only a handful of dots, and the brightest cell shows a sheet, not membrane rings. I see no specific myeloid population.
